The saved reference uses a separately written, unsplit primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun finite-volume code on 256 × 64 and 512 × 128 cells. Its generalized-minmod slope parameter is theta = 1.5 (MC-type, rather than canonical MC with theta = 2). The primary and reference codes share the HLL flux family and Heun time-integration equations, while their spatial reconstruction and implementations are separate. Conservative restriction produces comparison cell means. Previously executed source, data and receipts are reused from the immutable RKDG2D kit; no reference PDE, Athena or LAVA was executed anew for this addition. Reference grid differences indicate finite-resolution sensitivity, not rigorous error bounds. This is not an analytic 2D solution or a convergence test for the thin wall jet and vortex pattern. The incident discontinuity is classified at cell centers, rather than initialized from exact cut-cell averages. Compare against two previously independently executed finite-volume reference grids using conservative restriction. This is a finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact2D solution or error bound.
